question: Calculate the energy required to excite an electron in hydrogen atom from the ground state to the third orbit.

options.A: For hydrogen, $E_1=-13.6\text{ eV}$ and $E_3=-\dfrac{13.6}{9}\text{ eV}\approx-1.51\text{ eV}$. Hence the energy needed is $\Delta E=E_3-E_1=-1.51-(-13.6)\approx12.09\text{ eV}$.
options.C: The energy needed is $13.6\text{ eV}$ because excitation always means ionisation.
